result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue with a clipped restaurant name in the top-right carousel.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third restaurant 'Trattoria Piccolo' has its name clipped by the right edge of the screen, making it unreadable in full.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel layout to allow the full name to be visible, or add text wrapping/ellipsis with a tooltip for truncated names.
